tenderCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Bidder should have valid Class-3 and above Registered Electrical/ Civil Contractor License issued from Public Work Department or Inspectorate of Electricity.
The bidder should submit the GST/PAN Registration Certificate.

Tenderer in their name should submit annual turnover certificate any Two years from last five years i.e. 2021-22 to 2025-26 of Rs.4.68 Lakhs in each year.The turn over certificate should be mandatorily certified from charted accountant and mention UDIN number is compulsory otherwise it will be subjected to rejection.

The Tenderer should have at least executed and satisfactorily completed as prime contractor, at least one Similar nature of Work in any Govt. Agency/ULBs/PSU for amount not less than Rs.2.34 Lakhs in Last Five Years i.e., 2021-22, 2022-23, 2023-24, 2024-25 & 2025-26NOTE The work done certificate submitted should be signed not less than the rank of Executive Engineer/Equivalent grade officer and also mention the E-procurement indent number.

tenderSubEstimateList.subEstimateName: Replacement of existing non functional gas burners by new gas burners in Gas crematorium located at Kuvempunagar K block in ward no 57 of MCC limits

itemList.description:
Replacement of existing Power Gas Burner consisting of Double stage gas, Single Stage Operation for Natural Gas/LPG with inlet gas pressure 50 mbar suitable for Crematorium Furnace with following specification:
Model: OXG 14 TN SHI / OXG 18 TN SH / Equivalent Make
Burner Capacity : 35 - 148 Kw/hr, 30100 - 127280 Kcal/hr (or) 
45 - 180 Kw/hr 38500 - 154800 Kcal/hr
Gas Flow LPG : 2.6 - 11 kg/hr (or) 3.3 - 13.5 Kg/hr
Gas Flow NG : 3.5 - 14.8 nm3/hr (or) 4.5 - 18 nm3/hr
Combustion Air Blower : 130W / 250W, 2800 rpm, 50Hz
Electrical Connection : 230 V, 1 Ph
Flame Monitering : Ionization
Flame Dimensions (mm) : Length -200 - 740, Dia -110 - 170 (or) Length -290 - 910, Dia -130 - 200
Back Pressure : upto 4 mbar / 4.7 mbar depend on operating load
Scope of supply shall consist: Monobloc burner body set, Sequence controller, Ignition transformer, Air pressure switch, Inbuilt combustion air fan with blower motor, S.S. flame tube, Gas solenoid valve, Diffuzer Plate, Controlling panel, Gas valve fitting, Male Female socket, Ignition and Ionization Electrode, Electrode cable set with lugs, Gas combustion nozzle, Burner Flange gasket alongwith Installation, Testing & Commissioning inclusive of labour charges in complete manner as per the direction of Engineer-in-charge.
